paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to request further information about a neighbourhood recycling workshop. I am interested in sorting household waste and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to request further information about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am interested in [chủ đề] and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.
